journey: provider outage (a body provider goes down mid-task; the system holds honest UNKNOWN/DEGRADED state, re-plans when capacity returns, never silently pretends work continued — driven through the P12 composition-root exemplar apps/task-runner)

scenario.test_name: the full outage journey: down -> honest UNKNOWN -> capacity returns -> re-plan -> completion; the window stays visible

revisions.head_note: implementation_head is the lane-branch commit containing the suite sources and these evidence records; the finalization follow-up commit (evidence-only) records it. The architect gate binds to the branch head.

terminal_state.during_outage: provider UNAVAILABLE (typed window), lease SUSPECTED (truthful UNKNOWN — never LOST, never HEALTHY), task RUNNING with no new checkpoints, no completion, no fabricated verdict
terminal_state.on_capacity_return: window CLOSED -> provider AVAILABLE -> post-incident verified failure -> LOST -> recovery plan (cp-0002) -> replacement -> resume -> COMPLETED with final_verification.verified
terminal_state.without_verified_failure: SUSPECTED forever (truthful UNKNOWN), task never fabricates progress

evidence_graph_links: the outage window is typed: providerStatusOf(registry, 'task-runner-reference-cloud') reads UNAVAILABLE with the open window's detail verbatim, and the composition-root providerStatus() surface carries 'outage window open' — the provider view is honest in EVERY surface

no fake progress during the window: the task record stays RUNNING with the pre-outage checkpoints only (2) and final_verification null; the missed beat is SUSPECTED with UNKNOWN detail (never fabricated liveness, never fabricated death)
bounded backoff while degraded: two typed RETRY records then the ASK (the system asks instead of retrying forever — never an infinite loop, never an unrecorded retry)

the outage window is VISIBLE after the fact: the evidence-only cost ledger records OUTAGE_WINDOW_OPENED / OUTAGE_WINDOW_CLOSED / RECOVERY_PLANNED / RECOVERY_EXECUTED episodes (readLedger of the completed task record matches), and the timeline replays heartbeat UNKNOWN (lease.suspected) -> LOST (lease.lost) -> completion in order

the recovery plan inherits identity + the last durable checkpoint (cp-0002); the replacement is a different healthy spare on the recovered provider; completion is evidence-gated over prior + resumed outcomes
retained_uncertainty: the outage is a SIMULATED window over the injected InMemoryOutageRegistry (the provider report is scripted) — no real provider incident is observed; the deterministic seams stand in for it
the missed-beat UNKNOWN is honest: without a verified failure the lease stays SUSPECTED indefinitely (pinned by the second test) — the system never guesses death
cost accounting is evidence, never enforcement: the ledger episodes record the outage for audit and never gate, block or rewrite anything

outage_windows: task-runner-reference-cloud: OUTAGE window open at the world epoch ('the provider reports a region-wide capacity outage affecting reference cloud bodies'), closed on capacity return — simulated through InMemoryOutageRegistry
interruptions: KILL interrupt at work-program step index 5 (the capacity loss hits the leased body mid-task)
